Add now Scores Watch Betting FOX Super 6 💰 Stories Search Sign In Account SPORTS & TEAMS PLAYERS SHOWS PERSONALITIES TOPICS NASCAR Cup Series NASCAR Cup Series NASCAR Food City 500 Highlights, Recap: Ty Gibbs Wins at Bristol Updated: Apr 12, 2026 - 6:59 PM ET sharefacebookxredditlink 28741 We have a new winner at Bristol Motor Speedway. Ty Gibbs won Sunday's Food City 500, marking the first time since 2002 that there's been a new winner at Bristol Motor Speedway. It also marks Gibbs' first win of his career, but he had been on a hot streak prior to Sunday's victory. Gibbs had finished in the top six in each of the five previous races ahead of Sunday's Food City 500. Here are the highlights from Sunday's race! 13 posts Sort By NewestSort By NewestSort By Oldest Live Coverage for this has ended Apr 12, 2026 - 6:29p ET Ty Gibbs soaks it all in Ty Gibbs has won his first NASCAR Cup Series race and is celebrating as such! Apr 12, 2026 - 6:17p ET Ty Gibbs races to victory in overtime For the first time in 24 years, we have a new winner at Bristol. Ty Gibbs was able to race to victory on Sunday, fending off Ryan Blaney and Kyle Larson in overtime to win.Sunday's race needed overtime thanks to a crash between Riley Herbst and Kyle Bush with just over five laps remaining, bringing out the yellow flag. Apr 12, 2026 - 6:02p ET A late caution to throw a wrench into the race! It was Chase Elliott's turn to go around at Bristol near the end of Sunday's race. He was spun around with just over 20 laps remaining, causing the yellow flag to come out. Apr 12, 2026 - 5:27p ET Blaney out in front Kyle Larson has a new challenger. Ryan Blaney raced ahead of him on Lap 338, giving him the lead as Larson had led for 284 laps at that point in Sunday's race. Apr 12, 2026 - 5:22p ET Herbst takes Busch for a spin Riley Herbst and Kyle Busch were involved in a wreck in the middle portion of the final stage. Apr 12, 2026 - 4:51p ET Larson doubles up on stage victories It's the Kyle Larson show at Bristol. Last season's Cup Series champion won Stage 2 after getting a victory in Stage 1 on Sunday as he looks to get back-to-back victories in the Food City 500. Apr 12, 2026 - 4:18p ET Trouble on Lap 160! Several drivers were involved in a major wreck on Lap 160, including Shane Van Ginsberg, Alex Bowman and Todd Gilliland. Here's a closer look at how the crash went down. Apr 12, 2026 - 4:16p ET Christopher Bell in trouble Christopher Bell had a strong Stage 1, sitting in second through the first 125 laps. However, early in Stage 2, Bell's car got loose and he hit a wall, putting him in some trouble. Apr 12, 2026 - 4:03p ET Larson holds the lead after 1st stage Kyle Larson is your Stage 1 winner at Bristol. He was able to race to a lead of just over a second ahead of Christopher Bell through the first 125 laps. Ryan Blaney, meanwhile, was in third through the first stage. Apr 12, 2026 - 3:45p ET Brad Keselowski spins around and around We got a yellow flag early at Bristol, thanks to Ricky Stenhouse Jr. bumping Brad Keselowski. Apr 12, 2026 - 3:28p ET Ross Chastain hits send and flies toward the top after green flag The green flag has been raised, and it didn't take long for Ross Chastain to get involved in the action. Apr 12, 2026 - 2:16p ET Return of Alex Bowman Alex Bowman admits when he was dizzy and puking in his car during the race last month at Circuit of the Americas, he wasn’t sure if he would ever race again."When I got out at COTA, I was like, ‘This is probably it.’ That was what was going through my head," Bowman said at a news conference on Saturday."That sucked. And thankful that I get another shot at it."Bowman missed the next four races as he met with several doctors to treat his vertigo. He was cleared to race this week after driving a passenger car on a road course and being in the driver simulator, which mimics the feeling of driving the race car and is often a tool used to see if a driver has a return of neurological symptoms.The 33-year-old Hendrick Motorsports driver said primarily he had to get through those sessions without feeling dizzy, which he couldn't do in the few weeks after COTA."There was definitely, for me, concern but at the same time, just trying to get back feeling well enough to to do life," Bowman said.Read the rest of Bob Pockrass' piece on the return of fan-favorite Alex Boman.
